score: Masked L1 in [-1, 1] between the generated crop and the held-out frame, inside the SAM alpha. Lower is better.
protocol: One held-out crop from the last sampled second of each folder. FoundHand follows the Chaerin5/FoundHand demo: appearance anchor, target 2D keypoints as heatmaps, 250 denoising steps, classifier-free guidance 3.5. SPADE and pix2pix are the RTMW-l crop checkpoints trained in the same session.
decision: SPADE is the best of the three on this smoke. Do not download FoundHand-10M. The Drive checkpoint is already that pretraining, and it loses to SPADE on the factory crops.
